source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of balancing parentheses (PDF 99).

blocks.text: Infix expressions mein parentheses (brackets) batate hain ke kaunsa hisab pehle karna hai. Balancing parentheses ka matlab hai yeh check karna ke har khulne wale bracket ( ka band karne wala bracket ) maujood hai.

items: Khulne wale brackets ka hisab rakhne ke liye stack istemal karein.
Khulne wala bracket ( mile to use stack par push karein.
Band karne wala bracket ) mile to stack ka top pop karein.
Saare brackets parhne ke baad stack khali ho to brackets balanced hain.
Agar aakhir mein stack khali na ho, ya khali stack se pop karne ki koshish ho, to brackets balanced nahi.

blocks.text: Misal: (3 + 4) * (5 - 2) mein brackets balanced hain, kyunke har ( ka ek ) maujood hai.

blocks.prompt: Stack brackets ka balance kaise check karta hai (short question 4)? (a + b)) * (c ko check karein.
blocks.explanation: Har ( par push aur har ) par pop. Expression tab balanced hai jab kabhi khali stack se pop na karna pare aur aakhir mein stack khali ho. (a + b)) * (c mein doosra ) khali stack se pop karne ki koshish karta hai, is liye yeh balanced nahi.

items: ( push, ) par pop; balanced tab jab khali stack se pop na ho aur aakhir mein stack khali ho.
